title: Ho gaye ruqsat jahan se mominoo mola Naqi
body:
Haay naqi (as) mola
Haay naqi (as) mola
Ho gaye ruqsat jahan se mominoo mola Naqi.
Aaj phir Sadat ke ghar hai safey Matam bichi
1) kat Gayi roote jawani samera ki qaid me
Yaad kar kar ke aseeri sayyed e sajjad (as) ki
<<DIVIDER>>
2) sar me hai khake yateemi karte hai matam hasan
Zaher se baba ki zindaan Me shahadat Hogai
<<DIVIDER>>
3) gulshane aale nabi par hai udaasi Chaa gayi
Aa gaya zad me qhiza Ki hai guley baaghe naqi
<<DIVIDER>>
4) pee liya jaame shahadat aye mere daswey imam
Baqsh di islam ko yoo apne hai zindagi.
<<DIVIDER>>
5)ho naqi (as) ke qatiloo par har ghadi Allah ki maar
Bangaye motez mottawakal hashr tak hai laanati
<<DIVIDER>>
6)yoo uthi jawad mayyat shah ki pardes me
Khud qaza taboot par hai ashq barsati rahi
